Fewer dispatches (2-4) with larger payloads, trading memory footprint for reduced communication overhead.

strategies.name: Pipelined Overlapped Communication-Computation
strategies.desc: Uses non-blocking all-reduce operations (if available) to overlap the i-th all-reduce communication with local preparation of the (i+1)-th buffer's permutation and scaling. Dispatch count remains 8 but with potential latency hiding through asynchronous dispatch; trades implementation complexity for reduced wall-clock time.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction Tree
strategies.desc:
Exploits node/device topology by performing intra-node reductions (via shared memory or device-local all-reduce) followed by inter-node all-reduce, repeating 8 times. Total dispatch count is 16 (8 intra-node + 8 inter-node), but leverages faster local bandwidth for W/num_nodes of the data movement, trading dispatch count for bandwidth heterogeneity exploitation.

    S = 256
    W = world_size
    dtype = x.dtype

    a = [1.0 + 0.5 * (r % 3) for r in range(W)]
    perm = [(r + W // 2) % W for r in range(W)]
